notes: Historical figures are annual GAAP amounts: revenue and operating income (used as EBIT), depreciation and amortization, and capex proxied by cash-flow “Property Additions” from CSX’s FY2025 Form 10-K. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

NWC construction (for historical absolute NWC dollars) is defined as: (Total current assets minus cash and short-term investments) minus (Total current liabilities minus current maturities of long-term debt). Negative NWC reflects rail’s payables-driven working capital profile. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

EBIT margin forecast includes goodwill impairment embedded in GAAP operating income; the base case assumes margin normalization without explicitly modeling future discrete impairments. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))
WACC (0.095) is taken as a market-data modeling input (StockAnalysis) rather than a company-disclosed figure. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/csx/statistics/))

NOL balance and utilization percent were not located in the accessible text of the FY2025 Form 10-K (no explicit “NOL/net operating loss carryforward” figure found), so both are set to null. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

Comps EV multiples are reported as EV/ Sales and EV/EBITDA from StockAnalysis and are treated as proxies for EV/NTM metrics due to source limitations; they are included for directional sanity checking only. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/unp/statistics/))
Terminal method uses exit_multiple; terminal_growth is included as a modeling completeness parameter even though it is not the primary driver under exit-multiple valuation. (Assumption)

catalysts: Sustained improvement in merchandise/intermodal pricing and volume that lifts EBIT margin versus the FY2025 trough. (Assumption)
Execution of service/reliability initiatives that support operating leverage and cost control. (Assumption)

Capex normalization through 2026 consistent with management’s “<$2.4B” expectation, supporting free cash flow conversion. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))
company_overview: CSX is a U.S. freight railroad operator with four lines of business: merchandise, intermodal, coal, and trucking. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

The intermodal business operates a network of intermodal terminals (predominantly east of the Mississippi River) providing truck-like service for longer rail moves. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

In FY2025, the company generated $14.092B of revenue and $4.521B of operating income (operating margin 32.1%). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))
current_context: FY2025 results: revenue $14.092B (down from $14.540B), operating income $4.521B (down from $5.245B), and depreciation & amortization $1.680B. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

Capital intensity is elevated versus 2024/2023: FY2025 property additions/capex $2.902B. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

Management indicated planned capital investments for 2026 are expected to be less than $2.4B, consistent with a normalization step in the base-case capex profile. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes revenue growth returns to modest positives after FY2025 declines, consistent with low-single-digit progression in the modeled years. (Assumption)

EBIT margin mean-reverts from FY2025 32.1% toward the mid/high-30s range as cost/volume dynamics stabilize (modeled via rising EBIT margin). (Assumption; historical anchor shown in filings). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

DCF reinvestment discipline is centered on capex normalization toward <~17% of revenue in 2026 (aligned to “< $2.4B” guidance). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

Working-capital intensity remains moderately negative (rail payables-driven), reflected directly in the NWC% sales inputs. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))
key_risks: Demand/commodity cycle risk (notably coal/industrial) causing revenue and margin to undershoot modeled levels. ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))
Regulatory, labor, and infrastructure project risk leading to higher-than-planned maintenance or rebuild capex. (Assumption)
Downside case sensitivity to terminal multiple and long-run margin durability. (Assumption)

valuation_summary: DCF is structured as an operating-driver model anchored to FY2025 revenue ($14.092B), operating income (EBIT) ($4.521B), D&A ($1.680B), and capex/properties additions ($2.902B). ([d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net](https://d18rn0p25nwr6d.cloudfront.net/CIK-0000277948/6412cae9-586a-4f80-92ae-6305926bfc35.pdf))

Terminal value is computed using an exit-multiple approach (EV/EBITDA) with an economically consistent terminal multiple (13.5x base) and a long-run growth rate assumption included for completeness. (Assumption)
Comps provide a valuation sanity check using forward P/E and EV/EBITDA ranges from comparable transportation operators. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/unp/statistics/))
